name: Allstate
notes: Researched from public allstate.com help pages only (no sign-in). Pay in My Account / the app via the Payment Center, by scanning the QR code on the bill, through bank bill pay, through the agent, by phone 800-901-1732, or cash at Western Union Quick Collect. Express Access lets anyone view and pay a bill without logging in using policy number, last name and ZIP code. Automatic payments: Easy Pay Plan (bank account; lower installment fees and up to 5% premium discount on some policies) or Recurring Credit Card Pay Plan. Edit Auto Pay updates billing info, suspends one cycle, changes the date or cancels automatic payments. Paying with a credit or debit card drops Easy Pay and its discount for the rest of the term (not in California). Minimum amount due must be paid; payments cannot exceed the balance. Late or missed payments: agent or 1-866-998-8388. Paperless is eBill and ePolicy. Policy cancellation is not documented on the help pages, so the family default is kept. Review 2026-10-09: the public My Account login offers User ID or Email address with Password on one screen (modelled as email_or_username, one step). MFA is not documented publicly. help.title: How can I pay my bill?
paragraphs: Depending on your policy, you can pay in My Account or the Allstate mobile app, scan the QR code on your paper bill with a phone camera for a quick one-time electronic payment, pay through your bank's bill pay service, or ask your agent to process a one-time payment.
You can also call 800-901-1732, or pay cash at Western Union locations that offer Quick Collect.
You must pay at least the minimum amount due, and a payment cannot be more than your balance. You may make more than one payment in a billing period.

help.title: Easy Pay Plan and Recurring Credit Card Pay Plan
paragraphs: The Easy Pay Plan draws automatic payments from your bank account on the date you choose. It comes with lower installment fees and, on some policy types, a premium discount of up to 5%.
The Recurring Credit Card Pay Plan pre-authorizes payments on a credit or debit card on the date and frequency you pick.
Keep paying through the Payment Center until you receive your enrollment confirmation and withdrawal schedule.
Making a one-time card payment removes you from the Easy Pay Plan and its discount for the rest of the policy period (California customers are not affected).

help.title: Edit Auto Pay
paragraphs: In My Account or the app, open the Payment Center and choose Edit Auto Pay. From there you can update billing information, suspend one automatic payment for a single cycle, change the payment date, or cancel automatic payments completely.
You can also ask your Allstate agency to stop automatic payments. Restrictions or loss of savings may apply depending on your billing cycle.
steps: Choose to update, suspend, change the date or cancel.

help.title: Pay without logging in (Express Access)
paragraphs: Express Access lets you download ID cards and view and pay your bill without signing in. You need your policy number, last name and ZIP code.

help.title: Late or missed payments
paragraphs: A missed or late payment can lead to a lapse in coverage or cancellation of your policy.
If you have missed a payment or expect to be late, contact your agent or call Allstate customer service at 1-866-998-8388.

help.title: Go paperless with eBill and ePolicy
paragraphs: With eBill and ePolicy you get an email each time a new bill or policy document is ready to view online instead of receiving paper.
